title: Refactor Detail Panel Tree Gutter Alignment
description: Refactor the semio sketchpad Details panel tree layout so TreeSection, TreeItem, TreeRow, TreeContent, SortableTreeItems, and property-layout tree items render with a dedicated hierarchy gutter and one shared content start column. Preserve TreeContext behavior, PanelSection usage, property row/value-column layout, actions, expand-collapse, drag reorder, and data model. Keep tree guides continuous across subtree height and independent from row gaps.
summary: Reverted the over-flattened shared content-start alignment in the Details panel tree by restoring level-driven gutter widths and compact nested branch spacing in elements/ui. TreeContent, TreeItem, TreeSection, and sortable/property rows now keep hierarchy in the gutter, preserve continuous guide lines, and align controls locally per subtree instead of forcing one global vertical content line. Tuned the sketchpad right-side inspector slot spacing for a tighter Leva-style folder/control rhythm while keeping PanelSection registration, tree primitives, chevrons, widgets, add/remove actions, drag reordering, and the 160px value column intact. Verified with the elements/ui Vitest suite; sketchpad TypeScript checking still reports many unrelated pre-existing errors outside this change.
